parameters.code: var rig=UnityEngine.Object.FindFirstObjectByType<OVRCameraRig>(); var arc=rig.GetComponentsInChildren<UnityEngine.Transform>().Where(x=>x.name=="ArcOrigin").OrderBy(x=>(x.position-rig.rightHandAnchor.position).sqrMagnitude).First(); var oldLocal=new UnityEngine.Quaternion(-0.1097f,-0.5961f,-0.0421f,0.7943f).normalized; var offset=UnityEngine.Quaternion.Inverse(rig.trackingSpace.rotation*oldLocal)*arc.rotation; var target=UnityEngine.GameObject.Find("TargetZone").transform.position; var dir=target-arc.position; dir.y*=1.0f; var desired=UnityEngine.Quaternion.LookRotation(dir); var gripLocal=UnityEngine.Quaternion.Inverse(rig.trackingSpace.rotation)*desired*UnityEngine.Quaternion.Inverse(offset); return new {orientation=new float[]{-gripLocal.x,-gripLocal.y,gripLocal.z,gripLocal.w},arc=new float[]{arc.position.x,arc.position.y,arc.position.z},target=new float[]{target.x,target.y,target.z}};
